summary: BTC Digital Ltd., a Cayman Islands exempted company, reported via Form 6-K that it received a Nasdaq deficiency letter on August 27, 2026, for non-compliance with the minimum bid price rule (closing bid below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days). Nasdaq granted a 180-day compliance period until February 23, 2027. To regain compliance, the share price must close at $1.00 or above for at least ten consecutive business days. If not cured, the company may request an additional 180-day period, potentially by effecting a reverse stock split. Watch for potential reverse split announcement and delisting risk if price remains below $1.00.
